items.example: We made an observation about the sky.
items.exampleZh: 我们对天空进行了观察。

items.example: I write my diary every day.
The whale is swimming in the ocean.
items.exampleZh: 这只鲸鱼正在海洋里游动。

acceptedMeaningsZh: 动物园里的野生动物保护区
items.exampleZh: 我们参观了一个野生动物园。

acceptedMeaningsZh: 生活在河流里的哺乳动物

items.example: Let's go to see the museum.
items.exampleZh: 让我们一起去参观博物馆。

items.example: I will visit my grandmother tomorrow.
items.exampleZh: 我明天会去探望我的祖母。

items.example: We will take a truck tour to the mountains.
items.exampleZh: 我们将乘坐卡车去山区游览。

groups.sourceText: watch a movie / see a film

items.example: Let's watch a movie this evening.
items.exampleZh: 让我们今晚看一部电影吧。

items.example: I want to see a film tonight.
items.exampleZh: 我想今晚去看一场电影。

items.example: She is preparing for the exam.
This cake is better than that one.
items.exampleZh: 这块蛋糕比那块更好吃。

items.example: Can you find out the answer?
There is a threat to the forest.
A shark poses a threat to sea turtles.
The blue whale is very big.
We should interact with our teachers.
items.exampleZh: 我们应该和老师互动交流。
祝您假期愉快，尽情放松。

items.example: She wore a raincoat to school.
items.exampleZh: 她穿了一件雨衣去学校。

groups.sourceText: don't forget / forget to do sth.

items.example: I forgot to lock the door.
Can you bring me some water?

groups.sourceText: care for / take care of / take good care of

items.example: Please take good care of the flowers.

groups.sourceText: would like to join / would not like to join / wouldn't

items.example: I would like to join the club.
She wouldn't like to join us.
He is my best friend and he is very close to me.
items.exampleZh: 他是我的好朋友，他离我很近/很亲近我。

items.example: The house is close to the park.

items.meaningZh: 火烈鸟（一种红色的鸟类）
acceptedMeaningsZh: 火烈鸟（一种红色的鸟类）
items.example: Look at that beautiful flamingo in the lake.
items.exampleZh: 看湖里的那只美丽的火烈鸟。

items.example: All of them are ready to go.
items.exampleZh: 它们都准备好了要出发。

items.example: There are many babies in the hospital.
Try to feed the birds every morning.

groups.sourceText: be going to ... / be going to do

items.example: I am going to visit my grandparents.
items.exampleZh: 我打算去拜访我的祖父母。

items.example: I am going to go home.

groups.sourceText: give sb. sth. / give the baby sweets

items.example: We are getting closer to the finish line.
I can see you clearly now.
items.exampleZh: 我现在能清楚地看到你。

groups.sourceText: last week / last month / last year

items.example: I went to the park last week.
We visited my grandparents last month.
items.exampleZh: 我们上个月拜访了祖父母。

items.example: It was a wonderful day last year.
items.exampleZh: 那是去年一个美好的日子。
这两张照片看起来不一样。

items.example: She looks very different from her sister.
items.exampleZh: 她和她的姐姐看起来很不一样。

items.example: The children are crawling on the ground.
We spent the day resting at home.
items.exampleZh: 我们在家度过了一个休息的一天。

items.example: I don't know how to dive yet.
items.exampleZh: 我还不怎么知道如何潜水。

items.example: I saw him playing football in the park.
items.exampleZh: 我看见他在公园里踢足球了。

items.example: She gave birth to a baby.
The dog needs to be fed.
The cows feed grass every morning.
items.exampleZh: 这头牛每天早上都喂草。

items.example: I eat an apple every day.
